tools.description: Render a simple schema-driven widget in the host frontend and return structured user input. Use only for simple controls or legacy flows.

Render Layer 4 generated HTML/CSS/JS in a sandboxed iframe and return structured user input through window.submitWidget(values). Primary renderer for the prompt_keyword_grid and prompt_review widgets.

Generate an image from the confirmed refined prompt, save it to session uploads and return an actual compact attachment reference. Session registration is not a workflow layer: L2 Planner directly invokes this executor after instruction_ready, without L3/L4, and returns every result or failure to L1.
